data.title: Bauhaus
data.tagline: Organize the page with basic geometry, honest materials, and function
data.description: Exhibition and brand pages often let circles, squares, and triangles carry division, direction, and emphasis directly, with color only marking those functional relationships. If a page just spreads red, yellow, and blue blocks while the content organization stays unchanged, it borrowed the palette, not the Bauhaus.

distinctions.label: Swiss Typography
distinctions.explanation: Swiss Style communicates through a strict text grid and objective typography; in Bauhaus, geometry itself is the structure that organizes the page.

distinctions.label: Neubrutalism
distinctions.explanation: Neo-Brutalism uses heavy borders, hard shadows, and raw default controls for confrontation; Bauhaus composition serves function and balance instead.

use: Museum, exhibition, and cultural institution sites
Brand launches that build recognition through geometry
Design courses and workshops that emphasize structure
Cultural events that need a poster-like hero
avoid: Spreading red-yellow-blue blocks while the content structure stays the same
Adding shapes that relate to nothing on the page
Layering shapes until headlines and body text become hard to read
Setting long paragraphs in heavy geometric display type

lessonPractice.title: You asked the AI to take an exhibition site in a Bauhaus direction, and it only added red, yellow, and blue blocks without changing the content structure. How do you judge and respond?

options.label: Point out that a palette is not Bauhaus; every geometric shape must serve a function like dividing, pointing, or emphasizing
options.feedback: Bauhaus is judged by the geometry-function relationship; the style holds only when each shape has a clear job.

options.label: Accept it, since primary-color contrast is the core of Bauhaus and structure can stay
options.feedback: Primary colors are just the most memorable surface trait; blocks without functional roles are only a recolor.

options.label: Switch to a strict text grid with sans-serif type and remove the geometric shapes
options.feedback: That is the Swiss typography answer; it replaces geometric composition with grid order, which is a different movement.

data.agentPrompt: Take the exhibition home page in a Bauhaus direction: use circles, squares, and triangles to organize the hero and content sections, give every shape a job, and reserve primary colors for marking those functional relationships instead of filling decorative blocks. Afterwards explain what each shape is responsible for, then check the reading order at phone width.
